items.name: A1 Motorcycle License Course
items.description: For learners starting from zero experience riding motorcycles.
features: 20 days of highway code & theory classes
aptitude test preparation before your official learner license test with the Malawi Road Traffic Directorate

items.name: Code B (Light motor Vehicle) Driving License Course
features: 30 practical driving lessons, 30 minutes each day
20 days of highway code & theory classes
2 mock road tests with our instructors

items.name: C1 (Heavy Goods Vehicle Driving License Course)
items.description: For licensed drivers who want to rebuild confidence, skills and upgrade their licenses to drive heavy goods vehicles.
features: 20 days of highway code & theory classes
2 mock road tests with our instructors
Aptitude test preparation before your official license test with the Malawi Road Traffic Directorate

items.name: C (Heavy Goods Vehicle Driving License Course)-All big vehicles without trailer
items.description: For licensed drivers who want to drive all big vehicles without trailer.
features: 10 days of highway code & theory classes
2 mock road tests with our instructors
Aptitude test preparation before your official license test with the Malawi Road Traffic Directorate

items.name: CE - For aticulated trucks (Heavy Goods Vehicle Driving License Course)-All big vehicles with trailer
items.description: For licensed drivers who want to drive all big vehicles with trailer.
features: 10 days of highway code & theory classes
2 mock road tests with our instructors
Aptitude test preparation before your official license test with the Malawi Road Traffic Directorate
